text:
Alice_ACME: hey team — we started a live product demo and are getting a bunch of 429s around 12:02 UTC. Repro: running ~6 concurrent /v1/generate calls from one laptop (demo script).
Alice_ACME: sample curl we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-small\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'
```
Alice_ACME: Response had 429 + body `{\"error\":\"rate_limit_exceeded\"}`. Headers included: `x-rw-ratelimit-limit: 120`, `x-rw-ratelimit-remaining: 0`, `x-rw-ratelimit-reset: 12`. Can we get a temporary uplift? Demo in ~45m. cc @ben_support

ben_support: hey @Alice_ACME — sorry about that. Can you paste your org id and the email tied to the account? I can pull logs and we may be able to apply a short demo uplift. Also which plan are you on?

Alice_ACME: org: acme-inc-99, email: demo+acme@acme.com. We're on Free tier. 8 people remotely taking turns, so concurrency spikes.

support_bot: New ticket created: INC-202-1970 — category: rate_limit, priority: high (demo outage)

ben_support: From logs I'm seeing short bursts of concurrent requests from that org around the reported time. p50 latency ~70ms, no obvious server errors other than 429s. Free tier enforces lower concurrent request and token throughput. Options: 1) temp uplift for demo (sales approval), 2) client-side concurrency/backoff to smooth bursts, or 3) upgrade to Starter for predictable capacity. @sales_lucy can you assist with a one-time demo uplift?

sales_lucy: Hi @ben_support — I can approve a 2-hour demo uplift to Starter-equivalent limits. Need billing contact email and estimated peak RPS. This is a one-time manual uplift (no invoice).

Alice_ACME: thanks — billing contact demo+acme@acme.com, expected peak ~8 RPS, sustained ~2 RPS.

jordan_sre: For future: recommend adding client-side token bucket limiter and an exponential backoff on 429s. We can also whitelist for short windows; requires support to apply a temporary policy. Ben, I can prepare a quick runbook to avoid this during demos.

ben_support: applying temporary whitelist now for org acme-inc-99 until 14:30 UTC. Please re-run your demo and paste a few request/response headers if you still see issues.

Alice_ACME: re-ran at 12:25 — still saw a couple 429s but much reduced. Example header now: `x-rw-ratelimit-remaining: 3`. Demo proceeded after a couple retries. Thanks for the fast help.

sales_lucy: I'll have an AE reach out to discuss Starter (committed bursts) and options for recurring demos. No billing changes made; this was a temporary lift.

ben_support: summary: temporary uplift applied until 14:30 UTC, recommended upgrade to paid tier for predictable burst capacity or implement client-side concurrency control. Closing once you confirm demo finished.

Alice_ACME: confirmed demo finished, no further 429s. Really appreciate the quick turnaround :tada:
